subject: literacy
concept: Reading with expression that matches punctuation (periods, question marks, exclamation points)
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student practices changing their voice for a statement, a question, and an exclamation using the same simple sentence
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a spoken sentence's tone to the correct punctuation mark
exercise.abstract: Student reads a short passage aloud with expression matching its punctuation

assessment.mastery_threshold: reads passage applying at least 2 of 3 punctuation-expression cues correctly
misconception_flags: reads every sentence in the same flat tone regardless of punctuation

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
